segments.title: Station Cold-Open & Technical Difficulties
segments.notes: Pepito delivers sign-on from control room; broadcast feed exhibits spatial glitch placing anchor in void.

segments.title: Broadcast Abandonment & Game Selection
segments.notes: Anchor Case Blackwell foregoes news rundown, reveals failed internet prevented uploads, recruits Kendelle for co-op gaming session; selects Peak after Split Fiction uninstall discovered.

segments.title: Peak Gameplay — Island Concert & Mountain Ascent
segments.notes: Blackwell and Kendelle experience in-game BBNO$ concert, hallucination mechanics, and initial climbing phase; both sustain injuries from concert aftermath.

segments.title: Peak Gameplay — Kendall's Death & Solo Rescue
segments.notes: Kendelle falls to fog; Blackwell climbs alone through rising fog, navigates beetle swarm, reaches summit checkpoint and resurrects partner.

segments.title: Peak Gameplay — Desert Level & Wrestling Discourse
segments.notes: Sun exposure and tornado mechanics dominate; extended discussion of John Cena retirement match, Triple H creative direction, and AEW chants.

segments.title: Peak Gameplay — Cactus Maze & Walking Dead Talk
segments.notes: Poison cacti and hidden hazards force coordination; conversation covers Daryl Dixon spin-off, Fear the Walking Dead seasons, and zombie media preferences.

segments.title: Peak Gameplay — Ancient Luggage & Chain Launcher
segments.notes: Egg collectibles, chain launcher deployment, and fortified milk consumption; friend Kyle raids channel during traversal.

segments.title: Peak Gameplay — Final Climb & Double Death
segments.notes: Lava rise and piton mechanics test coordination; both anchors perish pursuing optional suitcase, ending run.

segments.title: Post-Game Wrap & Cosmetic Unlock
segments.notes: Blackwell acknowledges greed-induced failure; new smile cosmetic unlocked on death screen.

segments.title: Executive Confrontation
segments.notes: Chet Manscape interrupts sign-off to reprimand Blackwell for skipping scheduled news shift; Blackwell defends personal time.

segments.title: Raid & Broadcast Sign-Off
segments.notes: Blackwell raids small streamer after Kendelle vetoes larger targets; announces uncertain schedule pending song production and Frankenstein viewing.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered cold-open sign-on from control room while feed displayed anchor floating in void.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: anchor. Abandoned news broadcast for unsanctioned Peak co-op session with Kendelle; confronted by Chet for skipping shift.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Co-hosted entire Peak session from shared residence; died once, resurrected, died again in final lava sequence.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: recurring. Appeared untriggered at broadcast close to reprimand Blackwell for missing news shift.

lore_notes.fact: Case Blackwell and Kendelle cohabitate in the same residence.
Chet Manscape monitors Blackwell's broadcast attendance and confronts him live for skipping a scheduled news shift.
Blackwell's streaming setup includes a mirror reflecting full room layout visible to audience.
Blackwell indicates a song production session scheduled for potential next broadcast day.

episode_summary: Anchor Case Blackwell abandoned the scheduled news broadcast for an unsanctioned Peak co-op session with Kendelle, progressing through island concert, mountain, desert, and ancient luggage biomes before both perished in lava pursuing a suitcase. Chief Science Correspondent Chet Manscape interrupted the sign-off to reprimand Blackwell for missing his shift. The broadcast concluded with a raid on a small channel and uncertain forward schedule.
